comparison.objective: Insert a four-fork phase busbar into four circuit-breaker terminals; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block onto a service jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record aligns four forks and pushes them fully home together. Candidate butts a jig to a rail and slides a block continuously across the junction while preserving four circulating rows of loose balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires all forks home, hands clear and retention under a 5 N downward tug. Candidate requires complete transfer, all balls contained and no support gap, inclination, jam or damage.
comparison.reason: Multi-point insertion shares parallel alignment, but final terminal engagement does not test continuous support of freely moving rolling elements throughout a transfer.
